description: Represents a copy of an entire cluster or replication group as of the time when the snapshot was taken.

Key.description: The key name of the tag.

CacheClusterId.description: A unique identifier for the source cluster.

CacheNodeCreateTime.description: The date and time when the cache node was created in the source cluster.

CacheNodeId.description: The cache node identifier for the node in the source cluster.

CacheSize.description: The size of the cache on the source cache node.

NodeGroupId.description: A unique identifier for the source node group (shard).

SnapshotCreateTime.description: The date and time when the source node's metadata and cache data set was obtained for the snapshot.

SnapshotName.description: The name of a snapshot. Must be unique within the customer account.

CacheClusterId.description: The identifier of an existing cluster to create a snapshot from. The snapshot is created from this cluster.

ReplicationGroupId.description: The identifier of an existing replication group to create a snapshot from. The snapshot is created from this replication group.

SnapshotStatus.description: The status of the snapshot. Valid values: creating | available | restoring | copying | deleting | failed | deleted.

SnapshotSource.description: Indicates whether the snapshot is from an automatic backup (automated) or was created manually (manual).

KmsKeyId.description: The ID of the KMS key used to encrypt the snapshot.

Arn.description: The ARN (Amazon Resource Name) of the snapshot.

CacheNodeType.description: The name of the compute and memory capacity node type for the source cluster.

Engine.description: The name of the cache engine used by the source cluster.

EngineVersion.description: The version of the cache engine version used by the source cluster.

NumCacheNodes.description: The number of cache nodes in the source cluster.

NumNodeGroups.description: The number of node groups (shards) in this snapshot.

PreferredMaintenanceWindow.description: Specifies the weekly time range during which maintenance on the cluster is performed.

CacheParameterGroupName.description: The cache parameter group that is associated with the source cluster.

CacheSubnetGroupName.description: The name of the cache subnet group associated with the source cluster.

SnapshotRetentionLimit.description: For an automatic snapshot, the number of days for which ElastiCache retains the snapshot before deleting it.

SnapshotWindow.description: The daily time range during which ElastiCache takes daily snapshots of the source cluster.

TopicArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the topic used by the source cluster for publishing notifications.

Port.description: The port number used by each cache nodes in the source cluster.

PreferredAvailabilityZone.description: The name of the Availability Zone in which the source cluster is located.

VpcId.description: The Amazon Virtual Private Cloud identifier (VPC ID) of the cache subnet group for the source cluster.

AutoMinorVersionUpgrade.description: If true, opt-in to the next auto minor version upgrade campaign.

AutomaticFailover.description: Indicates the status of automatic failover for the source replication group.

ReplicationGroupDescription.description: A description of the source replication group.

DataTiering.description: Enables data tiering. Data tiering is only supported for replication groups using the r6gd node type.

CacheClusterCreateTime.description: The date and time when the source cluster was created.

NodeSnapshots.description: A list of the cache nodes in the source cluster.

Tags.description: A list of tags to be added to this resource.
